primary.title: Senco Gold Q1 update: Revenue jumps 60% on festive demand; SSSG at 38%, 8 new showrooms opened
primary.summary: Senco Gold's June quarter results showed a 60% increase in revenue and strong same-store sales. The company opened eight new showrooms and plans 12-15 more, targeting growth through inventory optimization and adapting to market conditions despite prior declines in stock performance.
